scientific_integrity: Analytic proof by time-preserving coordinate conjugacy, exact quadrature bounds, bounded convergence and total-variation control. The included finite numerical checks are illustrative only. No independent assessment or publication-priority certification is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Only the undamped Loud member with D=F=0 and the invariant region x<1 is treated.
The high-energy period leading term and exact undamped Toda quadrature were previously known and are not claimed as new.
Signed weak-star convergence is not an ordinary L1 limit; no explicit universal finite-energy error bounds are claimed.
The literature comparison is nonexhaustive; equivalent general hard-impact asymptotics could exist elsewhere.
title: A singular physical-time impulse law for a high-energy Loud center
